thread:
marta: Heads up — finance ops just flagged a stuck PO from a cross-listed seller in Azure Marketplace. PO 987654321 never hit the ledger acceptance record. Looks like vendor UUID mapping was null at ack time. Can eng + marketplace ops take a look?

raj: cc @oliver @sasha — saw a similar flake last week with cross-listings. could be the vendor-uuid TTL eviction during the marketplace accept window.

oliver: I can pull logs now. if the mapping service evicted the vendor record and the ack came in after TTL, the marketplace returns vendor_not_found and we never reconcile.

sasha: filing a support case with Azure team but timeline is unclear. putting the case id here: AZ-98377. they asked for the raw accept payload and the timestamp window.

marta: finance ops says customer was charged and then the PO stayed pending in our ledger, so revenue recognition is blocked. also legal flagged a signatory mismatch on the seller entity for this cross-listing — noting that could require a manual signature patch.


dani-legal: quick note: if signatory differs we need signed attestation or an updated MSA amendment. we can accept a scanned attestation for now to unblock billing, finance to confirm.

finance-bot: alert: PO 987654321 -> status: PENDING_LEDGER_SYNC. hold reason: vendor_lookup_failed.

oliver: pulled the service logs:
```
{ "event": "ack_receive", "po_id": "987654321", "vendor_uuid": null, "marketplace_response": { "code": 404, "error": "vendor_not_found" } }
```

raj: thanks. proposed mitigation: extend vendor UUID cache TTL from 15m -> 24h for sellers with cross-listing flag, and add a reconciliation job that retries vendor_lookup on PENDING_LEDGER_SYNC for 12h. low-risk change but needs a config rollout.

marta: can we do a short-term manual fix for this PO? finance can accept a manual ledger entry if legal provides attestation.


dani-legal: I can get the attestation signed today if partnerships emails the seller. who will own the outreach?

sasha: i'll reach out to the seller contact and request the attestation, sending a template. putting expected ETA: 4 hours.

oliver: once attestation is received, run the one-off ledger-attach script: `./tools/ledger_attach --po 987654321 --vendor-uuid <resolved-uuid>` — i can run it after confirmation. will also queue the reconciliation job.

raj: I'll open a PR for TTL change + reconciliation job, tag @eng-releases for canary. estimate 2d to deploy with tests.

marta: plan summary: 1) @sasha to get attestation (ETA 4h) 2) @dani-legal to review attestation 3) @oliver to run ledger_attach after attestation 4) @raj to ship TTL + reconciliation (2d) 5) @sasha to escalate with Azure if case AZ-98377 stalls. finance ops to confirm manual revenue treatment once ledger attached.

sasha: on it. updating the support case with logs and the manual-attach plan.

oliver: temporary playbook note for ops: if you see vendor_lookup_failed for cross-listing POs, add tag `crosslist-ttl-stick` and notify eng-oncall.

marta: thanks team — marking as escalation. will ping again after attestation. :thumbsup:
